description: One child has two anaesthetics in one stay. In the first, an infusion is ordered, started, changed in rate, paused, restarted, changed in rate again and never stopped, and its second change of rate is corrected retrospectively that afternoon by a row that names the row it amends. In the second, the same drug runs under a new order and is stopped, beside three short infusions whose drugs are unmapped, ambiguous and not listed.
